article.story: PITTSBURGH -- — Kam Woods had 19 points in top-seeded Robert Morris' 83-62 win over eight-seed Wright State on Thursday in the Horizon League Tournament quarterfinals. Robert Morris will play six-seed Oakland in a semifinal on Monday. Woods shot 7 for 17 (2 for 8 from 3-point range) and 3 of 8 from the free-throw line for the Colonials (24-8). DJ Smith scored 14 points while going 4 of 7 from the floor, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range, and 3 for 4 from the line and added seven assists. Ryan Prather Jr. shot 5 for 6, including 3 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 13 points. It was the seventh straight victory for the Colonials. The Raiders (15-18) were led by Brandon Noel, who recorded 15 points. Michael Imariagbe added 15 points and two blocks for Wright State. Alex Huibregtse also had 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
